scientific_integrity: The channel and its six survivor pairs are defined explicitly. Proof and two independent forms of executable reproduction are included; complete public primary text was read where accessible. No external independent audit or validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem covers length-six inputs and exactly two successive length-two deletion bursts; general-length and multi-burst cases are not claimed. The number of equality pairs is an exhaustive symbolic finite-pattern result for every alphabet size.
title: Sharp six-read reconstruction and equality-pair census for two length-two burst deletions
